Text mutex definition, initialization and nesting rules
Numeric opcode values for trap return call jumps and emulation helper effects
Address translation from batch entry to absolute address and ordered search implementation
Allocation bitmap creation, sizing and area allocator algorithm

findings.text: Early boot hook guarantees that the virtual CPU preemption capability is forced when the native preemption predicate is false, and leaves capabilities unchanged when native handling is already present.
Native preemption test holds exactly when the registered lock operation for virtual CPU preemption equals the native callee save implementation, otherwise paravirtual handling is assumed.
Two read only after init globals preserve the dedicated poke address space descriptor and its base address for use by later patch paths.

Copy and set patch helpers temporarily permit supervisor access around an inline memory primitive, and a common function type abstracts destination with source and length for interchange by the poke engine.
Debugger poke entry provides lock free patching by delegating directly to the internal poke engine with the copy helper.
Public copy and set patch entries serialize against each other through the shared text mutex, with unlock guaranteed after the internal poke work completes.

Set patch path treats patching core kernel text as a caller error signalled once and aborts with no update, and otherwise splits large ranges into page window bounded chunks to avoid spanning translation limits.
Remote synchronization helper performs core serialization on the receiving processor when invoked as a cross call target.

Batch poke entry stores a relative address against the kernel text base, a displacement for branch targets, length and opcode plus inline replacement bytes and a saved prior byte; entries live in a page sized vector with a count and per processor reference counters.
Batch vector capacity is one memory page divided by the size of one batch entry.

Batch vector lifetime uses per processor reference counts where acquisition succeeds only from a nonzero value and release pairs with a write barrier before decrement, coordinated with ordering against breakpoint publication.

Breakpoint handler for batched patching ignores user context and cases without an active batch, adjusts past the trap, locates the entry by direct compare for a singleton or ordered search otherwise, emulates return call and jump forms including conditional branches, leaves explicitly poked breakpoints for other handlers, and signals fatal error for unknown opcodes.
Remapping state keeps a physical base for the aperture, total byte size, page count, and a pointer to the translation table in memory.
Global flush control defaults to requesting a translation flush on every allocation.
Single bitmap spinlock guards the allocation bitmap with its next hint and the deferred flush flag across allocation, release and flush paths, always with interrupt state preserved.
Translation entry valid flag has value one, coherent flag has value two, and the highest mappable physical address is two raised to the fortieth power.

Entry encoding combines the page frame low portion with relocated high address bits and sets valid plus coherent flags, while decoding reconstructs the physical page address from those fields; a separate global holds the value written for unmapped entries and a bitmap tracks in use pages.

Linkage macro for shared AGP state has two build variants that either declare external linkage or leave the declaration local, allowing the same header text to serve both provider and consumer builds.

Aperture allocator honors device segment boundaries and caller alignment, resumes from a cached hint with wrap to the start on failure or exhaustion, records a pending flush on wrap or retry or when global full flush is set, and reports failure with an all ones offset.
Release clears the corresponding bitmap range and may move the allocation hint forward, while the flush path performs hardware invalidation exactly once per pending flag under the same lock.

Northbridge flush is skipped without the required feature, otherwise it serializes requesters with a private lock, issues a flush request to every present node, then polls each node until hardware clears the request, with a notice if no node was flushed.
Topology helpers expose feature presence by mask containment, safe indexed access to a northbridge descriptor with null on out of range, and total node count.
Stack dumper defaults a null task to current and derives the stack pointer for current when none is supplied, then delegates to the trace logger, so frames below the dumper are omitted for current.
Exhaustion path reports the failed byte size against the device without reclaiming space, and the optional leak dumper runs at most once per boot showing the current stack and DMA mappings.
Mapping need has forced and non forced forms where the forced form also honors a global force flag while the shared core defers to device DMA capability for the address range and attributes.

Contiguous aperture mapper rejects physical ranges above the architectural limit, allocates page count covering offset and length, populates consecutive translation entries while advancing by pages, and returns a bus address combining aperture base with page index and page offset.

Single range mapper fails memory mapped I/O attributes, bypasses translation with the original address when no remapping is needed, otherwise allocates aperture space and flushes translations before returning.

Single range unmapper warns once on the mapping error sentinel, ignores addresses outside the aperture as direct mappings needing no work, otherwise restores unmapped values across the covered pages and releases the bitmap range.

Scatter gather unmap stops at the first empty entry and delegates each populated entry to single unmap, while the non merging map fallback programs entries individually, unwinds prior entries on failure with an empty result, and always flushes.
Run mapper either passes through a single directly mappable entry or allocates one contiguous aperture run and fills its translation entries from the source pages, verifying the consumed page count.

Merging scatter gather mapper accumulates runs bounded by merge enablement, uniform remap need, page alignment, offset absence and device segment limits, flushes after successful runs with terminator handling, and on failure unwinds then retries without merging when forced or merging was active before reporting overflow with optional panic.

Coherent allocation starts from the direct allocator and only adds aperture remapping under forced translation for capable masks, undoing the direct allocation on mapping failure; freeing reverses any aperture mapping before direct release.
Aperture size selection defaults from firmware size halved when AGP remains, trims the tail to preserve directory alignment, and warns when the result is below sixty four megabytes.

Aperture discovery decodes base and order from configuration space with defined shifts and masks, derives size as thirty two megabytes scaled by order, and rejects zero size or ranges crossing the four gigabyte boundary.

Suspend resume support records aperture order and placement when requested, restores size and base on every capable node without yet enabling translation, then enables translations and flushes; the resume callback is registered through syscore operations.

Table initialization requires all present nodes to agree on a nonzero aperture base and size, allocates a zeroed table sized by aperture pages, marks it uncacheable, publishes the global table, registers resume support and flushes before announcing base and size.

Driver publishes a DMA operations table wiring its own map, unmap and coherent routines with common mmap and direct support helpers, alongside shutdown, init and option parsing entry points for lifecycle control.
